name: alpha-collision
vibe: A Swiss-modernist motion system charged with one electric accent: #28f02c lime cutting across near-black #060b09, deep pine and an electric-violet #4b3bff statement ground. Poppins does all the talking — ExtraBold headlines sliced in with machete wipes, SemiBold labels, Regular support — so the whole film reads as one typographic voice. The world is a slow ruled grid with a wide lime bloom, a drifting violet orb and a raking beam that sweeps across the 16:9 frame, so backgrounds keep moving even when copy holds. Beats alternate ground hard: black hook, violet claim, paper feature card with glowing ink screenshot plate, black tile wall, pine counters, black close with a lime glow button. Built for SaaS, AI, fintech, e-commerce and startup product promos that need screenshots shown large and brand colour rotated through every gradient, border, chip and glow.

assets.photoMod: Crisp editorial product and interface photography, hard directional key light plus one lime rim. Near-black or bone-white backdrops, shallow depth on hardware, screens tack sharp. Slight cyan-green shadow grade, neutral highlights, no bokeh clutter. Screenshots pixel-accurate, cropped to key UI.
